_about: Provenance of the captured-live-redacted Claude Code stream fixtures. These are field-level redactions of executor stream logs that the bridge itself captured during the two authorized live smokes on 2026-10-06 (T3: GLM operator -> bridge -> Claude Code; T4: Codex/Astra supervisor -> bridge -> Claude Code). No model was invoked to produce this file. The raw logs stay in state directories OUTSIDE this repository and are not published; only these redacted samples are.

integrity.events_added_or_removed: none; line count and event order of each original log are preserved exactly (T3: 25 events, T4: 27 events)
integrity.numbers: usage token counts, num_turns, duration_ms, total_cost_usd, thinking_tokens estimates are the real captured values
integrity.stream_shape: real; in particular the unrecognized rate_limit_event types are the actual events the CLI emitted

redaction.session_id: replaced, consistently within each file, with the fictional ids below; the mapping to real session ids is not recorded anywhere in this repository
redaction.tool_use_id: replaced with per-file fictional ids; the pairing between system permission_denied events and result.permission_denials entries is preserved by mapping each original id to one fictional id

values_replaced.result.result: [REDACTED EXECUTOR FINAL SUMMARY] (the executor's final summary prose; original text not published)

system:init: tools (26 real entries; tools_count therefore not asserted from live samples)
assistant: message.content and all other message fields (conversation and tool-call content), wire_tool_inputs (real tool inputs), wire_ingest_context, request_id, uuid, timestamp, parent_tool_use_id, thinking_duration_ms; message kept as {role, model}
user: message content, tool_use_result (real command output), tool_result_meta, uuid, timestamp, parent_tool_use_id; message kept as {role}
system:permission_denied: message (real command text with local paths), decision_reason, uuid
rate_limit_event: rate_limit_info (rate-window state incl. absolute reset timestamps)
result: usage.detail fields (output_tokens_details, server_tool_use, service_tier, cache_creation, inference_geo, iterations, speed, fallback_credit)
modelUsage per-model fields reduced to token counts and costUSD

t3_live_smoke_redacted.jsonl.run: T3 live smoke, task B (bridge-run slugify task, 1 attempt, 7 turns, verification passed, SUCCEEDED)

t4_live_smoke_redacted.jsonl.run: T4 single-run smoke, one bridge-run slugify task (1 attempt, 8 turns, verification passed, SUCCEEDED)
t4_live_smoke_redacted.jsonl.operator_harness: Codex local session (model gpt-6-astra, per local turn-context metadata)

evidence_boundary: Parser results on these files show the real captured stream shape parses and classifies as the runs did. They do not prove turn-limit enforcement, resume behaviour, or anything about other tasks or versions.
